caseStudy.title: TundraDesk
caseStudy.background:
TundraDesk offers multilingual support over documents mirrored into multiple regions. Search uses Cosmos DB for NoSQL, with documents partitioned by /tenantId. The assistant queries one tenant at a time. Users sometimes edit policy text and immediately ask for a new answer in the same session.

The container delivery pipeline uses a mutable candidate tag. Release engineering needs to guarantee that the tested artifact is the one promoted. Indexing notifications are delivered by Event Grid and can repeat or arrive out of order. Any version lower than the last stored version must be ignored.

The team observes that one tenant saturates its partition while total account usage looks modest. They also need a query that measures error volume per five-minute interval, split by service role.

exhibits.title: Cosmos request sample
exhibits.code:
partition key /tenantId, request tenant northwind
normalized RU consumption for tenant's physical partition: 100%
other observed partitions: 10–25%

exhibits.title: Related metrics
exhibits.code:
api version 3: candidate tag points to sha256:AAAA...
staging tested sha256:BBBB...
::
